deviations.what: c3/S15 'App lock · waiting for fingerprint · Android' and 'Fingerprint not recognised · Android' (S15__default__android360, S15__face-not-recognised__android360); also the 'Face ID' button of S15__pin-instead__android360: the Android capture (__android360) draws the Face ID glyph and the word 'Face ID' / 'Face not recognised' where the Android frame draws a fingerprint glyph, 'Fingerprint' / 'Fingerprint not recognised' and the caption 'Touch the sensor'
deviations.reason: [shared] FaceIdGlyph (app/lib/features/lock/widgets/face_id_glyph.dart) and the lock.biometric.* ARB keys name one method on every phone. The app does not yet name the method the phone uses (Face ID · Touch ID · Fingerprint · Face unlock). This is a defect against a 🔒 ruling, not a style choice: 'an Android fingerprint phone is never told Face ID'. It needs the gate to report which method it holds — a lock-feature change, not a re-skin
